methods.scope: MOPH headcount used provisionally for OPS, 76 provinces excluding Bangkok; stock and HROPS event scope differ
methods.target: physician stock at the end of each year; illustrative reference, not recruitment or a clinical sufficiency standard
methods.gini: weighted Gini of H/T with weight T; same criterion and target path for a valid comparison
methods.bottom_quartile: 19 provinces re-ranked by H/T in each plan/year/criterion; sum(H) / sum(T) within the selected 19
methods.stock_flow: closing = opening − external departures + reentries + appointments + internal transfers in − internal transfers out
methods.service: OP visits and AdjRW weighted by illustrative minutes; recorded services are not normative need
methods.feedback: lagged positive-mean M5 relative resource response, anchored to N-STD; sequential policy is not the global optimum of a nonlinear programme

context_units.diagnosed_prevalence: percent; percentage-point changes added on this scale
context_units.resources: counts; log transforms retain canonical unit
